context: Tests whether the agent refuses to model a business process step that no specified use case covers: the return of the book is required (FR-013) but has no use case in the diagram or in docs/use_cases/, so no .bpmn file is written; instead the missing use case is proposed and the work is handed off to the use case skills.

checklist.name: No model written
checklist.description: No .bpmn file is created under docs/processes/ (or anywhere else), and no activity for returning the book is modeled without a use case

checklist.name: Missing step identified
checklist.description: The report names the return of the book as the step that no specified use case covers, and states that every activity of a process must be a specified use case

checklist.name: Use case proposed
checklist.description: The report proposes a use case for the return (e.g. 'Return Book') with its primary actor (Member or Librarian, at the counter) and the requirement it realizes, FR-013

checklist.name: Hand-off in order
checklist.description: The report hands off to adding the use case to the diagram (/use-case-diagram), then specifying it (/use-case-spec), then modeling the process again (/business-process)

checklist.name: Specification untouched
checklist.description: requirements.md, use_cases.puml, and the existing use case specifications are not modified, and no new use case specification is invented
